versions.changelog:
- Added support for MaxFrame documentation and API navigation—users can now ask questions about MaxFrame APIs, concepts, usage, and compatibility.
- Enhanced scenario detection logic to handle documentation-only queries (Scenario 0), in addition to coding, debugging, and custom runtime scenarios.
- Updated workflow and rules to clearly separate documentation navigation from code implementation.
- Improved operator selection logic, allowing bypass when the user explicitly names the operation.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md and refined documentation for conciseness and accuracy.

alibabacloud-odps-maxframe-coding v0.0.1

- Initial release of the MaxFrame coding skill for Alibaba Cloud MaxCompute (ODPS).
- Provides workflows for creating, debugging, and customizing MaxFrame-based data processing jobs.
- Includes mandatory scenario detection and operator confirmation before code implementation.
- Features best practices for session management, error handling, and guidance on remote/local debugging and custom runtime builds.
- Documentation optimized for clarity and step-by-step user support.
